strings.en: Your misfortune was facing me. Resign yourself.
Meeting on the battlefield is fate. Prepare yourself!
I bear you no grudge,/　but I will take your life. Have at you!
Enemies must be fought./　As a knight, I must accept that fate.
A battle with a strong opponent.../　I would be lying if I said my heart did not stir.
Al-Van Ranks, here I come!
As a knight of the Fury, I challenge you!
Charge, Raftclans Aurun!
The strong... those who wield power./　A worthy opponent!
One who bears a sword needs no hesitation./　Have at you!
Receive the attack of my sword,/　the Raftclans Aurun!
I cannot let you escape...!
If I take its propulsion, even a Throne Unit...!
I will stop you!
Got you!
Take this!
Behold my swordsmanship!
Here I come!
Seiyah!
Hah!
Can you parry this?!
Seiyaaah!!
The Bellzelute... I cannot leave it be.
...Must I at least strip it of its fighting power?
So you have come after all... But I, too, must fight.
It cannot be helped. Forgive me...!
There is no room for talk... Naturally.
If you will not change your mind, so be it./　I will at least destroy that machine.
Karin... I never imagined fighting you/　would be this painful...
This is the last chance./　For you, and for me...!
That pilot is skilled. I must not let my guard down.
The new model sighted the other day, then.
Counterfeit or not, it is a weapon that fought Vaula./　I cannot take it lightly.
The machine that sealed Vaula./　Show me its power.
By rights, we should share a common enemy.../　Is this fate as well?
To think I would end up fighting that man's son.../　Is this destiny as well?
The other Shune.../　Now that you have activated Busker Mode,/　I cannot let my guard down.
The Throne Unit/　must be returned to our hands...!
Your movements have improved.../　Is it the work of Shune's blood?
This time, I will take back the Throne Unit...!
The Throne Unit and your power/　should be used for the Fury...!
Sänger Sombold.../　Al-Van Ranks, a knight of the Fury,/　will be your opponent!
Sänger Sombold, here I come!
My sword or yours.../　Shall we test which is superior?!
You are one who must not exist in this world./　Return to the darkness of Voda!
Take this back!
Then allow me to answer in kind!
I cannot let you escape!
I will teach you the difference/　between courage and recklessness...!
You will not retreat? Then so be it!
I accept this challenge!
You cannot escape my reach.
No intention of retreating? Then here I come!
I will give you no chance to escape!
I let my guard down...!
Kh! My Raftclans...!
You do well, facing me...!
To think I would be driven back this far...!
Kh! My inexperience is no laughing matter!
Did I misjudge their power...?!
You can fight me as an equal, or better...!
To think my Raftclans/　would be pushed back this far...!
Nngh...!/　I must fight in a way that brings no shame to a knight!
I, Al-Van Ranks,/　cannot retreat yet!
Lord E-Selda struck first...!/　But!
Ngh! Busker Mode?!
Kh! No wonder you were able/　to activate that mode...!
To think I would struggle against you...!/　As expected, Shune's blood/　is not to be underestimated.
Kh, that power is reminiscent of Lord E-Selda...!
Must I get serious as well...?!
I can feel the hatred...!/　But I cannot be defeated!
I will accept that hatred...!/　But I, too, cannot fall here!
Karin,/　I cannot let this chance slip away...!
Nngh!/　Splendid, Sänger Sombold!
Driven back this far by a counterfeit.../　Carelessness? No... That one is strong./　In that case!
As long as I fight that machine,/　must I accept the disruption to the Cytron...?!
I cannot be struck down by Vaula...!
Oh, not bad.
Quite something. Worthy of praise.
Good skill, but still naive.
I see... They are desperate as well.
To catch me... A formidable opponent.
A knight of the Fury does not flinch yet!
Is that all? Do not underestimate me.
You can match/　this Raftclans Aurun...!
A good attack./　But not enough to stop the Raftclans.
Far from what that man was, but...!
So you've come this far... boy!
Kh, he's beginning to show power/　worthy of piloting the Throne Unit...!
You read my movements...!/　Indeed, it is something you would be capable of.
That hatred... Must I accept it?
Karin... Will you reject me to the end?
As I thought, you are no ordinary opponent,/　Sänger Sombold!
This pressure.../　My Cytron Control is wavering...!
Counterfeit or not, mastered/　it can do this much...!
To think Vaula/　would wield its power for humans...!
This much is nothing.
Child's play. Come at me with everything you have.
You challenge me with so little skill...
Is that how you mean to stop me?
My Raftclans will not be shaken by damage this slight.
Do not think that will stop a knight.
I, Al-Van Ranks,/　will not be shaken by that much.
Too shallow. Come at me with everything!
Heh, a good read...!
He can hit me... That boy...
He seems to be growing used/　to handling the Throne Unit.
So this is the power of Shune's blood.../　But it is shallow!
Did I misread your anger...?
If I let him do as he pleases,/　he can land a hit, it seems...
Karin, you read my movements...!
You should know, Karin./　That this much will not make me flinch.
Surely that is not all you have,/　Sänger Sombold!
No wonder you could stand/　against Vaula.
Fluctuations in my/　Cytron Control? Is that counterfeit/　system the cause...?
So you hit me, Vaula.
Sloppy aim.
Inexperienced.
I can easily see through that much.
You underestimated this Raftclans.
That will not work on me, Al-Van Ranks.
You may have activated that mode,/　but your movements are rough.
You seem to have gotten better/　at handling the Throne Unit, but...
I cannot let your attack hit me.
The habits in your attack motions/　have not changed...
Karin, I...
Such an attack will not work on me.
Come at me with your life on the line.
Laughable... You think you can catch me with that?
My beloved machine, which fought through/　the great war of old.../　It will not be scratched so easily.
An impressive charge, but.../　I dodged it, Sänger Sombold.
Such an attack has no effect.
How pointless...
That attack will not work.
You will not get through the Orgone Cloud.
The Orgone Cloud can block it completely.
You chose the wrong method of attack.
That trick won't work.
Hm... I cannot counter. How unlike me.
A blunder... I cannot strike.
Have I been drawn into my opponent's pace?
I must change my position.
For an enemy, you move well...
You managed to escape well...
Did you forget I was here...?!
With such poor awareness...!
Jua-Mu, I will take it from here.
Leave the rest to me, Jua-Mu.
Fu-Ruu, I will take it from here.
I will not let you have your way!
Fall back. I will take that.
Jua-Mu, regroup!
Jua-Mu, do not let your guard down on the battlefield!
Retreat, Fu-Ruu!
You will not escape with such sloppy moves!
Prepare yourself!
Take this blow!
There!
Fall!
I won't miss!
I have read your movements... In that case!
At this range!
Orgone Claw, deploy!
Moving to close combat!
Orgone Claw!
Got you!
Take this!
You're mine!
One more strike!
Receive this, Orgone Cannon!
Orgone Cannon, wide-area mode!
Orgone Materialization...!
Receive the ever-changing blade.
Orgonite Mirage!
Sever!!
Hmph!
Hyaah!
Come forth,/　Orgonite Mirage!
Busker Mode, activate!
Materialization!
Behold my secret technique!
Hyah!
Haaaah!!
Now I shall show you the true worth of my sword!
Extractor, maximum!
This greatsword!
You can't parry this!
Prepare yourself!!
Haaaaah!!
Into the darkness of Voda...
Orgonite!
Busker!!
Swoooooord!!
All foes shall fall before this sword.
Haaah!
Raaaah!!
Not yet!
My sword has another form!
Extend, blade of Orgonite!
My true blade!
Haaaaaah!!
Into the abyss of Voda...
Sink!
A blow with everything I've got!
Feel it in your very body!!
Take thiiiiis!!
After the light, darkness comes.
